title: Interactive terminal setup
name: Interactive terminal setup
scope: Machine/universe first; optional project selection later
proposed_purpose: Complete necessary setup with the fewest decisions and an unambiguous handoff.
content: At the mode choice, say which computers can reach this universe: this machine only, your server, or Yoke Cloud.
At an identity/browser step, say why the browser opens, what to approve and how to return.
Allow a project now or later; when chosen, distinguish an existing checkout from a new project.
Keep GitHub integration optional. Silently keep item-to-issue sync off; no sync-choice screen.
Run routine checks automatically; show one plain repair step only when something needs attention.
End with the connected mode/universe, actual project or no project, active-harness readiness, and one concrete next action.

scope_variants.noProject: Finish machine setup; explain how to ask the agent to choose/add a project later.
scope_variants.projectChosen: Open that actual folder in the active harness and continue the existing onboarding handoff.
scope_variants.githubSkipped: Report skipped GitHub-dependent checks as not applicable, not setup failure.

authority_and_reuse: Use the existing setup state machine and its resumable steps. Longer explanations link to the manual; no workflow/QA/infrastructure course inside the TUI.
proposal_status: Proposed post-plan presentation; applies later user corrections over the older captured item 10/C/E wording
